Tested scope

The local R full check passed Status OK with 2,280 assertions and two explained finite-difference warnings. A fresh fixed-effects R/Julia fit agreed within coefficient 1e-5 and loglikelihood 1e-6 tolerances. These are bounded numerical and package checks, not all-route parity or scientific calibration.

Shared and persistent individual effects, process-specific SD predictors and reference-selection correction are inherited experimental routes. Their broad extraction-specific fit, output and interval combinations remain unqualified. Repeated-sampling recovery and interval coverage/calibration remain deferred. Shared-effect reference selection, shared-plus-individual combinations and random-effect or selection bridges are outside the current contract.
